summary: A local, versioned newline-delimited JSON bridge connects Axod to the Pi extension for exact session identity, ordered Pi events, and authenticated controls.
transport: Pi extension owns one private Unix-domain listener; Axod connects locally with a per-session bridge token.
framing: Newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON records with an 8 MiB maximum. Authentication uses protocol v1 and timing-safe token comparison. One connected Axod peer is accepted; events carry one UUID stream ID and increasing sequence numbers. Send text is limited to 64 KiB; duplicate command IDs replay cached results up to 256 entries.

messages.name: authenticate / authenticated
messages.summary: Axod sends protocolVersion and session bridge token; extension confirms version after constant-time token comparison.

messages.name: hello
messages.summary: Extension sends exact Axo session/pane IDs, Pi transcript ID/path, working directory and process ID after binding Pi's active Session.

messages.name: event
messages.summary: Pi lifecycle, message, turn, tool, UI-prompt and session metadata events are sequenced and published; transcript history remains recovery source if live delivery fails.

messages.name: command / commandResult
messages.summary: Axod can send text, cancel, shutdown or idle-only shutdown. Commands check session identity; replayed request IDs return cached result if action fingerprint matches.

messages.name: protocolError
messages.summary: Invalid envelopes or authentication terminate the local bridge connection.

parsing.summary: Extension config requires absolute bounded socket and transcript paths plus UUID session, pane and token values; identity is derived from Pi context and exact resolved transcript path. Commands are strict-key parsed and bound to the expected Axo session.

compatibility: Protocol v1; the extension and Axod are built/deployed as one product integration.
